svg.title: Imaging and Data-Center Equipment Broker Hub
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-imaging-and-power-broker-hub; chapter number: 11; title: Imaging and Data-Center Equipment Broker Hub; subtitle: Buy as the facility exits, prove identity, resell whole or as parts; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Imaging and power equipment broker; headcount: Not reported by practitioners; focus: Prove technical identity with tube scan seconds, software licenses, nameplates, battery date codes, and acceptance test reports.; spokes: role: Exiting hospital or clinic seller; type: Supply source; kpi: Year, make, model, tube age, licensed software, and gantry photos front, back, and side before pricing; role: Reconditioning partner; type: Value add; kpi: 40 to 50% below new with a one-year all-inclusive warranty baseline; ISO 13485 certified; role: Data-center decommissioning specialist; type: Teardown and resale; kpi: $12,000 paid to owner, room cleared in 10 days; generator load bank tested before resale; role: Buyer of refurbished system; type: Demand; kpi: $335,000 six-year MRI cost-of-ownership savings; caption: Block Imaging says new can cost up to twice the price of used or refurbished; Reclaim Atlas recovered removal cost through generator and UPS resale.; assumptions note: MRI savings combine a 210 purchase gap (805 OEM vs. 595 MXR) with post-warranty service at $85,000 instead of $110,000 per year. Oak Ridge teardown covered a 225 kVA UPS and a 180 kW standby generator.; note: Sources - MXR Imaging, Block Imaging, Reclaim Atlas, Probo Medical UK, and Keentel Engineering.
